integrity: Complete analytic argument and executable internal symbolic/rational checks are supplied. No independent audit or external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact scalar iid positive-curvature common-minimizer model only; optimizes the maximal admissible stepsize, not convergence rate. High-variance necessary cutoff algebraically appears in Kidambi et al. 2018; low-variance optimized transition and sufficiency are the narrow novelty claim. An earlier equivalent random-recursion classification remains a precedence risk.
title: The coefficient-of-variation phase transition for stability-margin-optimal stochastic heavy ball
